title: KCD 2 Director Praises GTA 6 Tech While Questioning Showcase
description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 director Daniel Vávra praises GTA 6 technology while raising questions about other aspects of Rockstar's recent showcase.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Director Shares Mixed Take on GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of Rockstar Games' *Grand Theft Auto VI*, industry figures are also weighing in on what the upcoming blockbuster has to offer. Recently, Daniel Vávra, director of the highly anticipated *Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2*, shared his perspective on GTA 6, praising its technological achievements while expressing doubts about other elements.

### A Developer's Perspective on Rockstar's Showcase

According to a report by GameRant, Vávra offered praise for the technology powering GTA 6. Given the massive scale and technical fidelity associated with Rockstar's titles, it comes as no surprise that a fellow developer would acknowledge the sheer graphical and engineering prowess on display. For creators working within the open-world genre, the technological benchmarks set by the GTA franchise often serve as a talking point across the industry.

However, Vávra's comments were not entirely without reservation. Alongside his praise for the game's technology, he reportedly questioned other aspects of Rockstar's recent showcase. While the specifics of his critique were not heavily detailed in the initial reports, the remarks highlight the diverse opinions and standards held by developers regarding modern game design and marketing showcases.

### Anticipation Continues to Build

As Rockstar continues to keep details close to the chest, commentary from prominent industry directors like Vávra adds an intriguing layer to the ongoing discourse surrounding GTA 6. Whether these questions stem from stylistic choices, design philosophies, or presentation methods remains a topic of speculation for fans and analysts alike.

## Editor's Take

It is always fascinating to see industry insiders evaluate each other's work. Daniel Vávra's measured response—acknowledging GTA 6's undeniable technical brilliance while questioning other facets—reminds us that top-tier developers view these massive showcases through a very different lens than everyday players. It adds a healthy dose of professional critique to the overwhelming hype surrounding Rockstar's next masterpiece.
